content: Hi - give me a rundown of my character

Greetings, **RozRaid**! Here is a comprehensive tactical breakdown of your character profile, highlighting your current strengths, key milestones, bottleneck skills, and strategic recommendations tailored to your active goals.

---

### 🛡️ Character Overview: RozRaid

* **Combat Level:** 134
* **Total Level:** 2,348 / Total XP: 118,117,339
* **Quests Completed:** 240 / 363
* **Signature Skill:** **Necromancy** (Level 106 | 28.2M XP)
* **Maxed Skills:** 🔥 [Firemaking](https://runescape.wiki/w/Firemaking) (Level 99)
* **Key Unlocks:** [Full Slayer Helmet](https://runescape.wiki/w/Full_slayer_helmet), [Ancient Curses](https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_Curses) unlocked via [The Temple at Senntisten](https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Temple_at_Senntisten).

---

### 📊 Stat Breakdown & Core Capabilities

| Category | Level | Status / Highlight |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Necromancy** | **106** | **Primary Combat Style.** Extremely high capability; driving your combat level and account progression. |
| **Slayer** | **95** | High-tier slayer access with [Full Slayer Helmet](https://runescape.wiki/w/Full_slayer_helmet) unlocked. |
| **Other Combat** | **81–93** | Constitution (93), Defence (89), Attack/Strength/Magic/Ranged (81–86). |
| **Prayer** | **84** | Has access to [Ancient Curses](https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_Curses); target **92/95** for [Soul Split](https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Split) & [Turmoil](https://runescape.wiki/w/Turmoil). |
| **Herblore** | **75** | Needs pushing toward **96** for [Overload](https://runescape.wiki/w/Overload) potions. |
| **Invention** | **48** | **Core Bottleneck.** Unlocked, but under-leveled for high-end gear augmentation. |
| **Archaeology** | **86** | Great progress; unlocking essential passive relics. |
| **Dungeoneering**| **64** | **Gatekeeper Skill.** Holding back access to Prifddinas. |

---

### ⚔️ Profile Analysis & Key Insights

#### 1. 🔮 Necromancy Specialist (Goal: 120 Necromancy & All Quests)
* **Current Push:** You have been heavily grinding Necromancy (hitting 106 recently) and completed **Tomes of the Warlock**.
* **Necroplasm Strategy:** To reach **120 Necromancy** efficiently, your goal to convert all lower-tier Necroplasm into [Powerful Necroplasm](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_necroplasm) is crucial. This will support high-level disturbance rituals and crafting [Greater/Powerful Inks](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_ghostly_ink) for high alteration glyphs.
* **Remaining Necro Quests:** Focus on completing remaining Necromancy quests (such as [Alpha and Omega](https://runescape.wiki/w/Alpha_and_Omega)) as you hit requirement levels to unlock maximum tier gear and talent upgrades.

#### 2. 🦅 Favorite Bossing Target: [Kree'arra](https://runescape.wiki/w/Kree%27arra)
* With 106 Necromancy, **Kree'arra** in the [God Wars Dungeon](https://runescape.wiki/w/God_Wars_Dungeon) is extremely easy to farm. Necromancy's high accuracy bypasses Kree'arra's traditional ranged-only weakness mechanics effectively.
* Coupled with your 95 Slayer and [Full Slayer Helmet](https://runescape.wiki/w/Full_slayer_helmet), taking Aviansie or boss tasks makes Kree'arra ideal for fast combat XP, pet hunting, and God Wars collection logs.

#### 3. 🔑 Prifddinas Unlock Progress ([Plague's End](https://runescape.wiki/w/Plague%27s_End))
* You have already completed [Within the Light](https://runescape.wiki/w/Within_the_Light), which is a huge quest barrier removed!
* **Requirements Met:** Mining (79), Woodcutting (76), Crafting (82), Construction (74—close!), Agility (82), Herblore (75), Ranged (81), Prayer (84), Summoning (78).
* **The Only Missing Requirement:** **75 Dungeoneering** (currently level 64). Pushing Dungeoneering 11 levels will unlock [Plague's End](https://runescape.wiki/w/Plague%27s_End) and grant access to the city of Prifddinas.

---

### 🎯 Actionable Master Plan

1. **Fuel the 120 Necromancy Push**:
   * Use your rituals to process Necroplasm into [Powerful Necroplasm](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_necroplasm).
   * Craft [Powerful Ghostly Ink](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_ghostly_ink) to set up Tier 3 Alteration Glyphs for max XP disturbance events (like *Corrupt Apparitions* and *Defile*).
2. **Train Invention (Level 48 → 70+)**:
   * Augment your Necromancy weapons/armor while training to 120. Leveling up augmented gear and siphoning/disassembling it will passively grant massive [Invention Training](https://runescape.wiki/w/Invention_training) XP while you train Necromancy or do Slayer.
3. **Bridge the Dungeoneering Gap (64 → 75)**:
   * Run solo/group floors or take advantage of daily [Sinkholes](https://runescape.wiki/w/Sinkholes) to hit 75 Dungeoneering and unlock [Plague's End](https://runescape.wiki/w/Plague%27s_End).
4. **Bossing Runs**:
   * Take your Necromancy setup to [Kree'arra Strategies](https://runescape.wiki/w/Kree%27arra/Strategies) whenever you want a high-sustained DPS bossing session or combat break.
